Name: Various Recolours and Masks
Author: sqbr
Description:
A collection of mods to change the grass/dirt/water, green tree foliage, red tree foliage, tree wood, and flowers to be more blue. I created these as preliminary steps for creating and testing my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13365]Weird Recolour[/url], and are primarily of use as masks for other people wanting to make their own (probably less weird) recolours. But if you want to use them as actual mods then they will work like any other Content Patcher mod.

Goth Fall: Makes the red and orange foliage of trees in fall a little more blue.
Goth Flowers: Makes the red parts of flowers desaturated.
Goth Ground: Makes the grass, dirt, and water purple-blue
Goth Wood: Makes the wood of trees more purple.
